title: Unsubscribe route lacks behavioral coverage
reasoning: The URL is registered for an externally reachable unsubscribe endpoint, and existing tests only verify that generated emails/templates include an unsubscribe URL and token. None of the included tests exercise GET requests to the unsubscribe, success, or error routes, nor do they assert valid-token, missing-token, invalid-token, expired-token, idempotency, or profile opt-out effects. Because this endpoint crosses network and user-input trust boundaries, a broken view or URL contract could ship while all included tests still pass.
recommendation: Add focused Django client tests for reverse('notifications:unsubscribe') covering valid signed token opt-out, missing/invalid/expired token handling, redirect/render behavior for success and error pages, and idempotent repeated unsubscribe requests.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests generate or look for unsubscribe URLs, but they do not call the route or assert database state changes from the unsubscribe flow.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a subscribed user/profile, sign the user id the same way promotional email generation does, GET the unsubscribe URL with the token, assert the response follows the expected success path and receive_promotional_emails becomes False; add separate cases for missing and tampered tokens reaching the error path without changing state.
minimumFixScope: Add tests for notifications unsubscribe routes; implementation changes are only needed if those tests reveal mismatched behavior.
